messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
According to the MA STAR manual, if the load nut breaks through due to wear and the safety nut takes over the whole load, can the vehicle still be lowered?

response.text: Secondo il manuale MA STAR, se il dado di carico cede per usura e il dado di sicurezza assorbe l'intero carico, il veicolo può comunque essere abbassato?
